finding: Virtual benchmark of end-to-end discovery cycles (hypothesis, experiment, analysis, act). Three baseline agents (ReAct, Plan+Execute, Hypothesizer) struggle; humans do far better.
numbers: 120 tasks, 8 topics x 3 difficulties. Human average completion 66%, knowledge 55% (up to 11 scientists, 16 tasks). Best agent completes 38% of easy and 18% of challenge tasks; best knowledge discovery (Hypothesizer) 34% easy, 8% challenge. Easy tasks 100 steps, others 1000.
limits: Weaker models of 2024; simulated worlds, not real notebooks.
agent_relevance: Step order can be logged and compared with human traces; agents fail at the end-to-end loop.
